title: Deeper/broader open-source reader-writer route and consumer-policy crosswalk
mode: Primary project documentation and issue review cross-checked against existing local plan owners
scope: Compare current open-source DWG/DXF implementation routes by format, direction, and evidence ceiling.
Refresh the ACadSharp and ACadRust peer issue signals most relevant to local table, spline, ownership, and auxiliary-object work.
Reconcile peer claims with LibreCAD 3's read-only DWG product policy and current DXF/3D consumer boundaries.
Refine only existing PAR-06, PAR-07, PAR-49, PAR-119, and PAR-126 implementation/evidence owners.

method.remote_review: Read-only review of primary project documentation, release notes, and issue pages; no mutable peer sample was treated as a pinned artifact.
local_checks: Mapped LibreDWG, ACadSharp, ACadRust, ezdxf, GDAL, and LibreCAD 3 to the current PAR owners and kept direction/version/route distinctions.
Reconciled ACadSharp #1253, #1261, and #1299 with existing HATCH, GEODATA, and SPLINE evidence; no issue was treated as a local reproduction.
Reconciled ACadRust #130, #133, and #134 with existing TABLE, owner-closure, and bounded auxiliary-object work; private corpus and candidate fixes remain unverified.
Updated only DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md and this research receipt; no production code, test code, fixtures, dependencies, metadata, or support claims changed.
method.limitations: Peer issue bodies are reporter evidence and do not establish local behavior or normative format rules. ACadRust #133/#134 rely on private customer corpora; #134 candidate changes lack a public corpus retest. ACadSharp #1253 contains a producer/profile-dependent HATCH group-47 discussion and remains unresolved. GDAL and ezdxf expose projected or explicitly partial semantics. No peer binary, drawing, native CAD application, or geometry kernel was executed.

sources.name: LibreDWG 0.14.1 NEWS
sources.observed: Release notes enumerate concrete DWG/DXF fixes, including R2004 page/decompression safety, HATCH handling, table/style fields, handle ownership, and the final inline-SAT chunk. These are route- and release-specific changes, not proof of broad semantic support.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Project release notes only. Pin release, commit, build, direction, format version, and per-record result for comparator use; keep GPL-3.0 source-port compatibility separate.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1253
sources.observed: The report describes AutoCAD 2027 rejection of output from ACadSharp 3.6.35 and lists CLASSES, HATCH, and DIMSTYLE table-header concerns. A later comment refines the HATCH group-47 claim to derived paths; the issue page still does not establish a universal presence rule or a local defect.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Version/producer-specific peer report. Existing local HATCH characterization and version-scoped DIMSTYLE evidence remain the applicable gates.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1261
sources.observed: The issue reports an ACadSharp DWG writer GEODATA CIVIL-tail omission and AutoCAD failure but does not identify the exact source/output magic needed to establish the target-version branch.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer-only trigger. The local PAR-119/7BP gate follows ODA's versioned target contract and generated boundary controls.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1299
sources.observed: The v3.8.0 report says a DWG-to-DXF result contains SPLINE data rejected by a later GDAL conversion, but provides no public exact failing handle, curve arrays, diagnostic options, or independent expected curve in the issue text.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Discovery lead only. Keep under existing PAR-22/7H/7I; do not infer a spline grammar or expected geometry from the report title.

sources.name: ACadRust issue #130
sources.observed: The report separates DWG merged-cell ranges and table-style suppression flags from the corresponding DXF per-cell and per-field representation, describing a cross-format transfer gap in the peer.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer route evidence only. Local TABLE/TABLECONTENT remains scoped to PAR-126/7G.3d and preserves tagged alternatives rather than synthesizing values.

sources.name: ACadRust issue #133
sources.observed: The reporter describes orphaned anonymous dimension-block children being re-homed into model space, creating phantom geometry; the comparison uses a private 351-DWG corpus and an ODA File Converter DWG-to-DXF route.
sources.evidence_ceiling: High-value owner-disposition test shape, not an independently inspectable corpus or local failure. Keep missing/ambiguous owners unresolved; do not infer model-space membership.

sources.name: ACadRust issue #134
sources.observed: The report says ACadRust 0.6.4 rejects 70 of 351 private AC1032 files that 0.6.3 opened; 65 failures map to MLEADER context data and the remainder to associative objects/table parsing. Candidate commit 0e46236 is linked, but no public corpus retest is recorded.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer regression and bounded-record diagnostic shape only. Do not weaken local record bounds or treat a candidate commit as verified behavior.

sources.name: ezdxf 1.4.5 ACIS API
sources.observed: Documentation states that arbitrary ACIS load/edit/re-export is not a goal, unsupported entities may be lost, and mesh conversion only represents flat polygonal faces without an ACIS kernel.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Useful exact-profile DXF/carrier comparator; not a DWG codec, arbitrary ACIS validator, or curved B-rep semantic oracle.

sources.name: GDAL DXF driver documentation
sources.observed: The driver documents Binary DXF reading from GDAL 3.12 and an optional AC1027+ mode that exposes ASM bytes and transform rather than constructing 3D geometry. OGR projection omits or simplifies CAD-specific information by design.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Use only for exact projection/consumer questions; the separate DWG driver dependency and operation must not be attributed to the DXF route.

sources.name: LibreCAD 3 DWG support policy
sources.observed: Current policy says DWG import is opt-in and read-only, the pinned library ledger is frozen with 15 read claims (11 experimental and 4 pending-native), none promoted, and no DWG write claim exists. The document requires separate promoted write claims, independent reopen, and a project decision before enabling save.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Downstream product policy and pinned-ledger summary, not a second parser implementation or runtime result.

assessment.plan_impact: Refines peer admission and identity/owner disposition under the existing associative, object-graph, TABLE, GEODATA, SPLINE, and 3D evidence owners. The next local slices remain non-blocked by peer availability. LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3 2D consumer compatibility is preserved; no DWG write product claim is inferred from library implementation.
